description: React component for a tour tip related to 'Burn-on-read' messages in the Mattermost application, including UI rendering, user interaction handling, and preferences management.

classes.name: BurnOnReadTourTip
classes.description: React functional component implementing a tour tip for burn-on-read messages, managing display logic, user interactions, and preferences.

methods.name: BurnOnReadTourTip
methods.description: React component function that renders the tour tip UI and handles user interactions.

methods.name: markTourTipAsSeen
methods.description: Saves user preference indicating the tour tip has been viewed.

methods.name: handleOpen
methods.description: Handles opening the tour tip when the pulsating dot is clicked.

methods.name: handleDismiss
methods.description: Handles dismissing the tour tip and marking it as seen.

methods.name: handleTryItOut
methods.description: Handles the 'Try it out' button click, marking the tip as seen and invoking the provided callback.
